title: Authentic Roasted Italian Emmentaler Cheese Paccheri Pasta
description: A comforting and creamy roasted Italian pasta dish featuring Emmentaler cheese and paccheri pasta, perfect for a sick day or a cozy evening at home. This egg-free friendly recipe is a classic Roman dish with a twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, Emmentaler cheese, and sauteed garlic and onion mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional Emmentaler cheese.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
